verdicts.reason: A separates the gold leaf wreath from the 'Perfect Taste' headline: the wreath ends up cropped at the bottom edge over the figs, and the small headline floats on its own on a blurry, empty crop with no visible product. B keeps the wreath and headline together as a single lockup, so the brand mark stays intact. But it shrinks the lockup to a tiny badge that is hard to read at banner size, and the image crop still shows only blurred fig fragments, with empty space on both sides.
